title: The Bridge Crossing Problem
prompt: Four people, one flashlight, one rickety bridge, seventeen minutes. The bridge holds at most two people at a time, and anyone crossing needs the flashlight. Alone, they cross in 1, 2, 5 and 10 minutes; a pair moves at the slower person's pace. Get everyone across in 17 minutes.
solutionSteps: Send the 1 and 2 across together (2 minutes). The 1 brings the flashlight back (1 minute). Running total: 3.
Send the 5 and 10 across together (10 minutes). This is the key move — pair the two slowest so you only pay for the 10 once. Running total: 13.
The 2, already on the far side, walks the flashlight back (2 minutes). Running total: 15.
The 1 and 2 cross together again (2 minutes). Total: 17 minutes, everyone across.
The trap is escorting everyone with the fastest person, which costs 1 + 10 + 1 + 5 + 1 + 2 = 19 minutes. Pairing the slow walkers beats shuttling.
